# USA TODAY
> USA TODAY delivers breaking national and local news, sports, entertainment, money, technology, travel, and lifestyle coverage through award-winning journalism, photos, and video.

USA TODAY is a major U.S. news publisher covering current events, politics, business, sports, culture, and consumer topics, alongside opinion, investigative reporting, games, and subscription products.

## Main News
- [Homepage](https://www.usatoday.com/): Front page for breaking news, top stories, video, and coverage across major USA TODAY sections.
- [Nation](https://www.usatoday.com/news/nation/): U.S. national news coverage, breaking developments, public safety, and major domestic stories.
- [World](https://www.usatoday.com/news/world/): International news, geopolitics, conflicts, diplomacy, and global current events.
- [Politics](https://www.usatoday.com/news/politics/): Coverage of the White House, Congress, elections, policy, and political analysis.
- [Investigations](https://www.usatoday.com/news/investigations/): Investigative reporting on accountability, corruption, public systems, and in-depth enterprise stories.
- [Weather](https://www.usatoday.com/weather/): Weather forecasts, storm coverage, climate-related news, and severe weather updates.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://www.usatoday.com/sports/): Sports hub with scores, analysis, schedules, standings, and coverage across major leagues.
- [NFL](https://www.usatoday.com/sports/nfl/): NFL news, game analysis, trades, draft coverage, and team updates.
- [NBA](https://www.usatoday.com/sports/nba/): NBA news, playoffs, player movement, scores, and league analysis.
- [MLB](https://www.usatoday.com/sports/mlb/): Baseball coverage including MLB scores, standings, trades, and postseason news.
- [NHL](https://www.usatoday.com/sports/nhl/): Hockey news, game results, playoff coverage, and league developments.
- [College Football](https://www.usatoday.com/sports/ncaaf/): NCAA football rankings, game coverage, recruiting, and season analysis.
- [College Basketball](https://www.usatoday.com/sports/ncaab/): NCAA basketball news, rankings, tournament coverage, and team updates.
- [Golf](https://www.usatoday.com/sports/golf/): PGA, majors, player news, tournament results, and golf analysis.

## Entertainment & Culture
- [Entertainment](https://www.usatoday.com/entertainment/): News on movies, television, music, books, celebrities, and pop culture.
- [Movies](https://www.usatoday.com/entertainment/movies/): Film news, reviews, trailers, box office coverage, and awards-season reporting.
- [TV](https://www.usatoday.com/entertainment/tv/): Television news, streaming coverage, reviews, interviews, and series updates.
- [Music](https://www.usatoday.com/entertainment/music/): Music industry news, artist interviews, releases, tours, and awards coverage.
- [Celebrities](https://www.usatoday.com/entertainment/celebrities/): Celebrity news, interviews, red carpet coverage, and trending entertainment stories.
- [Books](https://www.usatoday.com/entertainment/books/): Book news, author interviews, bestseller coverage, and literary features.

## Money & Technology
- [Money](https://www.usatoday.com/money/): Business, markets, personal finance, consumer news, and economic coverage.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.usatoday.com/money/personalfinance/): Guidance on saving, debt, taxes, retirement, and household financial decisions.
- [Markets](https://www.usatoday.com/money/markets/): Stock market news, investing updates, economic indicators, and market analysis.
- [Economy](https://www.usatoday.com/money/economy/): Coverage of inflation, jobs, growth, policy, and broader economic trends.
- [Technology](https://www.usatoday.com/tech/): Tech news covering devices, platforms, AI, apps, privacy, and digital culture.
- [Reviewed](https://www.usatoday.com/reviewed/): Product reviews, buying guides, deals coverage, and consumer recommendations from USA TODAY.

## Life, Health & Food
- [Life](https://www.usatoday.com/life/): Lifestyle coverage spanning wellness, relationships, parenting, food, and culture.
- [Health](https://www.usatoday.com/story/life/health-wellness/): Health and wellness reporting on medical news, fitness, and healthy living.
- [Food](https://www.usatoday.com/story/life/food-dining/): Food and dining stories, recipes, restaurant trends, and culinary features.
- [Wellness](https://www.usatoday.com/story/life/health-wellness/wellness/): Wellness-focused content on habits, mental health, exercise, and self-care.
- [Humankind](https://www.usatoday.com/humankind/): Uplifting human-interest stories, community features, and inspiring video journalism.
- [Women of the Year](https://www.usatoday.com/women-of-the-year/): Profiles and recognition of influential women making impact across fields.

## Travel
- [Travel](https://www.usatoday.com/travel/): Travel news, destination ideas, airline coverage, tips, and trip-planning advice.
- [Destinations](https://www.usatoday.com/travel/destinations/): Destination guides, city features, and inspiration for domestic and international travel.
- [Airline News](https://www.usatoday.com/travel/airline-news/): Airline industry updates, passenger policies, route changes, and travel disruptions.
- [Cruises](https://www.usatoday.com/travel/cruises/): Cruise news, ship updates, itinerary coverage, and passenger travel advice.
- [Hotels](https://www.usatoday.com/travel/hotels/): Hotel news, lodging trends, openings, and accommodation recommendations.
- [Experience America](https://www.usatoday.com/experience-america/): Travel-focused features highlighting places, experiences, and destinations across the United States.

## Opinion & Analysis
- [Opinion](https://www.usatoday.com/opinion/): Editorials, guest essays, columns, and commentary on major issues and current events.
- [Columnists](https://www.usatoday.com/opinion/columnists/): Opinion pieces and recurring analysis from USA TODAY columnists and contributors.
- [Editorial Board](https://www.usatoday.com/opinion/editorials/): Official editorial board positions and institutional viewpoints on public issues.
- [Voices](https://www.usatoday.com/opinion/voices/): Guest perspectives and essays from outside contributors on timely topics.

## Visual, Video & Interactive
- [Video](https://www.usatoday.com/videos/): Video reports, interviews, explainers, highlights, and visual storytelling across beats.
- [Pictures](https://www.usatoday.com/picture-gallery/): Photo galleries covering news, sports, entertainment, and feature storytelling.
- [Graphics](https://www.usatoday.com/graphics/): Data visualizations, interactives, and graphic-driven explanatory journalism.
- [Podcasts](https://www.usatoday.com/podcasts/): Podcast directory featuring news, sports, and topical audio programming.

## Games & Puzzles
- [Games](https://www.usatoday.com/games/): Hub for online games, puzzles, crosswords, and daily brain teasers.
- [Crossword](https://www.usatoday.com/games/crossword/): Daily crossword puzzles and archive access for word-game players.
- [Sudoku](https://www.usatoday.com/games/sudoku/): Daily Sudoku puzzles with multiple difficulty levels.
- [Word Games](https://www.usatoday.com/games/word-games/): Word-based puzzle collection including daily and casual play options.

## Subscriptions & Account
- [Subscribe](https://subscribe.usatoday.com/): Digital and print subscription offers for USA TODAY news and premium access.
- [eNewspaper](https://www.usatoday.com/epaper/): Digital replica edition of the print newspaper for subscribers.
- [Help Center](https://help.usatoday.com/): Customer support for subscriptions, billing, delivery, and account management.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.usatoday.com/terms-of-service/): Legal terms governing use of USA TODAY websites, apps, and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.usatoday.com/privacy-policy/): Privacy practices, data collection details, and user rights information.
